## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-*juǎn* topical outline (*kē* 科 — a structural diagram of the parent text) for the *[Shì Móhēyǎn lùn 釋摩訶衍論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0084)*, compiled by the Sòng monk [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80) (Pǔguān, also Pǔjì 普覺?) of *Yuánzhèngguāngyán wújì dàshī* 圓證光嚴無際大師 honorific. The work is preserved only in the *Manji-zokuzōkyō* 卍續藏經 (X46). A *kē* (科文) is the standard East Asian Buddhist genre of analytical structural outline — a hierarchical break-down of the parent text's argumentative structure used for memorisation and pedagogical exposition. It is conceptually parallel to a Western scholastic *summa* outline.

**Abstract**

The text opens "釋摩訶衍論科卷下 / 皇宋圓證光嚴無際大師普觀治定" and proceeds with a hierarchical outline using the standard Sòng-period typography (○, *chū* 初, *èr* 二, *sān* 三, etc.). The author Pǔguān is also the compiler of [KR6o0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0089) (a longer prose record on the same parent text); the two works are paired (the *kē* is the structural outline, the *jì* is the running commentary). Both are preserved together in the *Manji-zokuzōkyō*. Pǔguān is otherwise poorly attested in standard biographical sources (*Sòng gāosēng zhuàn* 宋高僧傳); internal evidence places him loosely in the Northern or Southern Sòng period. His honorific *Yuánzhèngguāngyán wújì dàshī* suggests he was a Buddhist scholastic of some standing at one of the major Sòng monastic complexes.
